title: Teri Shadi Ka Arman Bohat Tha
body:
Laila ne kaha lasha e akbar pe tadap kar
Is dil me teri shadi ka arman Bohat tha
<<DIVIDER>>
Dulha na bana paayi tujhe Teri ye madar
Is dil me teri shadi ka arman Bohat tha.
<<DIVIDER>>
.1. Atthara baras soch ke maine ye guzare.
Armaan kisi roz nikalungi me saare..
Ghash khaati thi ye peet k kehti thi kbhi sar
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Kohraam shahe wala k khaimon me bapa tha
Jb khaq pe shabeer ne laashe ko rakha tha
Har bibi sada deti thi haye haye mere akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Aye laal mere qalb pe ye daagh hai gehra
dulha na bana payi saja payi na sehra
hai kitni khalish kaise bataun tujhe dilbar.
<<DIVIDER>>
.4. Barchi tere sine me lagi jab se suna hai.
Ankhon me meri noor na aye beta raha hai.
Takrai hu khaimon ki tanabo se muqarrar.
<<DIVIDER>>
.5. Sunti hu ke bahar tera aya hai kaleja..
Acaha hai ke ankhon se mujhe kuch nhi dikhta
Mar jati magar dekh nhi paati yeh manzar.
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Dushvar hai waise to watan jana hi mera
Gar jaun watan ko to me sughra se kahun kya
ye hal tera sun ke kahegi teri khuwahar.
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Akbar phuppi amma ki zara dekh le halat.
Un ke bhi jo dil me thi na puri hui hasrat
Noha ye mere laal hai zainab ke labon par.
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Ek lamhe ko Johar nhi madar ko mila chain
Behosh hui laila ali karte hue bain
Phuta hai mere laal teri maa ka muqaddar
author: Mir Johar Shikarpuri
